descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

激光网迅速移动，将§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!和另外几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]切成了碎片。
descriptions.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

The rapidly moving laser beams sliced §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] into tiny pieces.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被快速移动的网格切成了碎片。尽管§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!安然无恙，这些损失还是对项目产生了重大的不利影响。
descriptions.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were sliced into tiny pieces by the fast moving beams. Although §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! survived unscathed, these losses have had a negative impact on the project.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

很幸运，多亏了§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!的快速行动，激光在造成任何损失之前被无效化了。项目进度向前推进，超出了预期。
descriptions.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

Fortunately, thanks to the quick actions of §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! the lasers were disabled before they could cause any harm. The project is moving forwards, ahead of schedule.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

激光挡住了前进的唯一道路。无效化它们的代价很昂贵，但要找到另一条绕过激光网的路则会耗费很多时间。
descriptions.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

The lasers are blocking the only path forward. Disabling them will be expensive, but finding an alternative route around the laser grid would take a lot of time.

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

自动炮台在被关闭之前迅速地射杀了§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!和其他几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

The automated guns rapidly mowed down §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be disabled.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被困于他们的交火区域。§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!最终设法关闭了那些炮台，但死伤不可避免。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were caught in their firing zones. §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! eventually managed to disable the guns, but there were several fatalities.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

很幸运，§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!设法在有人受伤之前解除了那些自动炮台。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

Fortunately, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! managed to disable the automated guns before anyone was harmed.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

没有人受伤，但炮台挡住了前进的唯一道路。如果它们不能被解除，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]将不得不寻找另一条路线。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

No one was harmed, but the guns are blocking the only way forwards. If they can't be disabled, our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] will have to find an alternate route.

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

在暴走停下来之前，古老的半感性机器人将§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!碾成了肉末。
descriptions.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

The ancient and semi-sentient robot ground §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! into tiny pieces before its rampage could be stopped.

descriptions.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!设法从暴走的机器人手上捡回一条小命，但其他的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就没那么幸运了。
descriptions.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! managed to flee its rampage, but several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were not so lucky.

descriptions.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

凭借着经验和一点点运气，§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!设法在任何人受伤之前平息了机器人的暴走。
descriptions.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

With skill and a fair bit of luck, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! managed to halt the rampaging robot before anyone was injured.

descriptions.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

每个人都想避开暴走的机器人，但它昼夜不停的在我们前进的唯一道路上巡逻。如果不能关掉它，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]只能去寻找其他的路。
descriptions.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

Everyone managed to escape the rampaging robot, but it is now tirelessly patrolling the only way forward. Unless it can be disabled, our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] will have to look for another path.

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

这些敌对智能人在被武器火力干掉之前迅速解决了§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots made short work of §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! before they could be permanently deactivated with weapons fire.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

敌对智能人在被§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!阻止之前成功干掉了一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]。
descriptions.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots managed to kill several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be stopped by §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

万幸的是§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!与附近的安保人员在这些敌对智能人严重伤人之前就关闭了它们。
descriptions.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

Luckily, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! and the nearby security escort managed to neutralize the hostile robots before they could seriously injure anyone.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

那些敌对智能人暂时被牵制住了，但我们仍然无法通过它们。除非让这些机器人彻底停摆，否则我们就必须寻找另一条路线。
descriptions.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots have been contained for now, but there is no way past them. Unless they can be neutralized, an alternate route will have to be found.

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh: §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个古老的资源贮藏点。他们现在已经开始将这些物资装船运往我们的中央仓库。
descriptions.en: §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! discovered an ancient cache of resources among the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are even now in the process of being shipped off to our central stores.

descriptions.zh: §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!不久前在发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时发现了一段隐蔽的隧道！这个意想不到的发现加快了发掘进度。
descriptions.en: §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! recently found a hidden passage while excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]! This unexpected discovery has accelerated progress at the dig site.

descriptions.zh: 你的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然发现了之前在[From.Planet.GetName]进行的一次不幸的探险行动，那是很久以前的事了。我们的人从他们干枯的遗骸中找到了几件稀有文物。
descriptions.en: Your [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have stumbled upon an ill-fated previous expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] that perished long ago. Several minor artifacts were recovered from their desiccated remains.

descriptions.zh: 怒气冲天的争执在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古遗址爆发了出来，几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就如何最好地推进项目同§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!的意见产生了公开的分歧。该遗址的工程进展已经慢的如同蜗牛一般。
descriptions.en: Tempers are running high at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], and several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] are openly disagreeing with §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! about how best to proceed. Progress at the site has been slowed to a crawl.

descriptions.zh: 最近§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古发掘现场发现了一个小藏宝室！虽然发现的大多数小玩意儿几乎没有实际用途，但它们可值不少能量币。
descriptions.en: A small hidden treasure chamber was recently uncovered by §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! at the archaeological dig site on [From.Planet.GetName]. Although most of the found trinkets are of little practical use, they have a substantial energy credit value.

descriptions.zh: 考古人员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报道一种奇怪的疾病正在[From.Planet.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]间传播。首个病例在第一次打开密封室后不久被确认。由于很大一部分团队成员已经无法继续参与考古，遗迹的开发进展已经推迟。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that a strange sickness has been spreading among the [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName]. The first confirmed cases appeared shortly after a sealed chamber was opened for the first time. With a large part of the team incapacitated, progress has been delayed.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的考古探险队发来报告，由于一系列未曾预料的设备故障，工程出现了延期。在拿到替代设备之前，考察工作将暂时停滞。
descriptions.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has reported delays caused by an unlikely series of equipment malfunctions. Work has been halted momentarily until replacements can be acquired.

descriptions.zh: 当发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时，§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!消失的无影无踪了。一项由另一个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]领导的广泛的搜寻工作也一无所获。我们必须考虑到最坏的情况。
descriptions.en: While excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName], §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! recently vanished without a trace. An extensive search by the other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] turned up nothing. We have to assume the worst.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上持续的发掘工作出土了一小堆古董物件。[Root.GetLeaderName]在这之中鉴定出了一些稀有文物。
descriptions.en: Our continued excavations on [From.Planet.GetName] have unearthed a small cache of antique objects. [Root.GetLeaderName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

descriptions.zh: 一些稀有文物于近期由§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古站点上发现。它们目前正在运往一个安全的科学设施的途中。
descriptions.en: Some minor artifacts were recently discovered by §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are currently in the process of being shipped to a secure science facility.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上遗迹的发掘中，一部分地面最近发生了坍塌，使得我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]跌落到一个小裂口中。幸运的是他们不仅在事故中毫发无伤，还发现了一些稀有文物。
descriptions.en: A section of floor at the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName] recently gave way, sending several of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] tumbling down a small chasm. Fortunately they not only emerged unharmed from the incident, but they also found several minor artifacts.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

在我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]能够成功逃生之前，穷凶极恶的野兽撞上了他们。§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!与其他人失散了。
descriptions.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Before our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] could make their escape, the vicious animals were upon them. §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! was lost along with the others.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!能带领幸存者们抵达安全地点前失散了。
descriptions.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Many [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were lost before §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! could lead the survivors to safety.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

幸运的是，野兽们正处于冬眠，并且它们没有被我们[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]的通过所惊扰。项目的进度正在急速推进中。
descriptions.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Fortunately, the animals were hibernating and they were not disturbed by the passage of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]. The project is rapidly moving ahead.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

处理这些凶猛的野兽并不轻松，但是它们挡住了前方唯一的道路。我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]能够寻找到其他路径，但是这将花费一定时间。
descriptions.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Dealing with these vicious animals will not be easy, but they are blocking the only route forwards. Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] can look for an alternate path, but it will take time.

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

不幸的是，一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]头上的整块天花板发生了坍塌，当场去世。§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!也在牺牲者之列。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Unfortunately, an entire ceiling collapsed on several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural], killing them instantly. §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! was among them.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]于近期因天花板塌陷而死亡。§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!在废墟中毫发无伤地站了起来，但是站点的工作暂时停止了。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were recently killed when a ceiling collapsed on them. §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! emerged unscathed from the debris, but work at the site has been momentarily halted.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

幸运的是，§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!成功设计出了一种标新立异且杰出卓越的方法，利用复杂的定向能量场阵列来提供结构支撑。我们现在能够安全地进入遗迹的新区域了。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Fortunately, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! managed to devise an unorthodox and brilliant way of providing structural support with a complex array of directed energy fields. We can now safely access new areas of the ruins.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

在我们继续前进之前，支撑系统必须被仔细地添加到地面和天花板。这将是一项艰巨的工作，但是寻找另一条路线会延缓整个项目。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Supports will have to be carefully added to the floors and ceilings before we can proceed. It will be difficult work, but finding an alternate route would delay the project.

label.zh: 安全第一。稳定这些遗迹。

label.en: They will have to go around.

descriptions.zh: 古老并且部分被翻译的记录已经在[From.Planet.GetName]上被挖掘的废墟中发现。§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!报告说这份记录包含着一些能对我们科学家有益处的技术细节。
descriptions.en: Ancient, partially translated records have been discovered amongst the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName]. §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! reports that the records contain several technical specifications that may be of value to our scientists.

descriptions.zh: 大前天晚上，首席考古学家[From.Leader.GetName]报告说看到了令人不安的景象，并且一直被关在自己的房间里直到现在。他们认为是我们这里的某种东西引发的……
descriptions.en: Three nights ago, chief archaeologist [From.Leader.GetName] reported having a disturbing vision and has been shut away in their quarters until now. They believed the source to be whatever is down here with us...

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行的探险扰乱了一些当地野生动物腐烂的茧壳，它们现在似乎受到寄生真菌的影响。这些真菌僵尸立即开始袭击我们，显然是被我们营地和我们身体内部的水源所吸引。

僵尸们在被我们的安全团队把它们烧光之前迅速地杀死了§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§!。干枯的遗骸就是他们遗留下来的全部了。
descriptions.en:
The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

The zombies made short work of §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! before they could be burned down by our security team. Their desiccated remains are all that is left of them.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行的探险扰乱了一些当地野生动物腐烂的茧壳，它们现在似乎受到寄生真菌的影响。这些真菌僵尸立即开始袭击我们，显然是被我们营地和我们身体内部的水源所吸引。

在被[Root.GetLeaderName]阻止之前，僵尸设法杀死了几个§H [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]§!。当我们试图找回他们时，他们干枯的尸体已经变成碎片。
descriptions.en:
The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

The zombies managed to kill several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be stopped by §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! Their desiccated corpses fell to pieces when we tried to recover them.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行的探险扰乱了一些当地野生动物腐烂的茧壳，它们现在似乎受到寄生真菌的影响。这些真菌僵尸立即开始袭击我们，显然是被我们营地和我们身体内部的水源所吸引。

幸运的是，§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! 附近的保安护卫设法在僵尸对任何人造成严重伤害之前将其无害化。
descriptions.en:
The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

Luckily, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! and the nearby security escort managed to neutralize the zombies before they could seriously injure anyone.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行的探险扰乱了一些当地野生动物腐烂的茧壳，它们现在似乎受到寄生真菌的影响。这些真菌僵尸立即开始袭击我们，显然是被我们营地和我们身体内部的水源所吸引。

丧尸暂时被控制住了，但没有办法越过它们。也许我们可以用足够多的水把它们引出来。
descriptions.en:
The expedition carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] has disturbed the decaying husks of some local wildlife, which seem now to be under the sway of parasitic fungi. These fungal zombies immediately began assaulting us, apparently drawn to sources of water in our camp and inside our very bodies.

The zombies have been contained for now, but there is no way past them. Perhaps we can lure them out with a sufficiently vast amount of water.

descriptions.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的科研团队发来紧急通讯！他们对丛林的鲁莽涉足似乎严重地激怒了一些当地的种群。

在几个夜晚中，团队成员看到了倏然闪过的阴影，在林下灌木从中时隐时现。然后，在月圆之夜，一支像猿类一样的生物组成的部队从天而降，嚎叫并挥舞着棍子。得益于我们先进的科技，这些袭击者很快被赶回了树上，不过还是有几名探险队的成员被他们掳走了。茂密的树林中还能听到他们哀嚎的回响。

尽管遭遇到了危险，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]许诺仍会继续探索。
descriptions.en:
Emergency transmission from the science team on [From.Planet.GetName]! Their rough foray into the jungle appears to have badly angered some of the local fauna.

Over the course of several nights, the team sighted fleeting shadows, half-glimpsed between the underbrush. Then, on the eve of the full moon, a troop of simian-like creatures descended on the expedition, howling and brandishing sticks. Given our technological advantage, these raiders were quickly driven back into the trees, but not before they had made off with several members of the team. We are told the dense foliage did little to muffle the screams.

Despite the danger, scientist [Root.GetLeaderName] has vowed to continue the expedition.

descriptions.zh: 我们从[From.Planet.GetName]上的探险队获悉了一条新消息。在迷宫般的丛林中探索比起先预期的还要困难。我们的团队每挣扎前进一步都要和意料之外的沼泽、坚硬诡异的藤蔓做斗争，同时还要面对那些出奇智慧的类猿生物。研究团队通过驯服一些温顺的有蹄类生物，终于是穿过了丛林中最困难的地区。它们还可以在巨大树木的树根下找到埋着某种类虫生物肉的埋藏点。因为这些生物看起来非常兴奋，这些虫肉一定是当地的某种美味佳肴。更重要的是，研究团队很快也从树林的地表下发掘出了一些制造物件，这些小发现也进一步表明了这颗行星上曾经存在着先驱文明。
descriptions.en: We have received an update from the expedition on [From.Planet.GetName]. Navigating the labyrinthine jungle has proven more challenging than initially hoped. As the team struggled to push forward, stymied by unexpected marshes and thick, creeping vines, they were approached by an unusually intelligent simian. Picking its way through the foliage on the back of a tamed ungulate, the creature led the team through the worst of the jungle. It also made sure to point out caches of edible insectoid larvae buried in the roots of the great trees. Given the creature's excited gestures, these must be something of a local delicacy. More importantly, the tip resulted in further evidence of the planet's precursor civilization, as the team quickly unearthed several artifacts from the forest floor.

label.zh: 那些猿类也没什么大不了的！

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的研究团队遭遇了一些困难。在树林中意外发现了一座蜿蜒崎岖的河谷，他们在丛林地表的探索近乎停滞了。汹涌的河水中尖石穿空，犬牙交错，从现在这条路线几乎无法通过。随之而来的绕道又带来了意想不到的后果：一支当地群居猿类的大队靠近了他们。这些长着斜眉毛的生物以取悦探险队为乐事，每晚他们都满载着大量发酵的浆果而来。尽管士气空前高涨，但进度仍然缓慢，项目领导汇报时警告整支团队可能缺失行动力。
descriptions.en: Hard times for the science team on [From.Planet.GetName]. Progress through the jungle ground to a near halt with the unexpected discovery of a river valley winding beneath the trees. The raging waters are stuttered with sharp rocks, and have proven impassable along the team's chosen course. The resulting detour has had surprising consequences: the arrival of a gregarious troop of local simians. These slope-browed creatures have delighted in entertaining the expedition, arriving each night laden with an extremely potent variety of fermented berry. Although morale is higher than ever, progress continues to slow, and the project lead reports an alarming lack of initiative among the team.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的研究团队遭遇了一些困难。在树林中意外发现了一座蜿蜒崎岖的河谷，他们在丛林地表的探索近乎停滞了。汹涌的河水中尖石穿空，犬牙交错，从现在这条路线几乎无法通过。随之而来的绕道又带来了意想不到的后果：一支当地群居猿类的大队靠近了他们。这些长着斜眉毛的生物以取悦探险队为乐事，每晚他们都满载着大量发酵的浆果而来。尽管我们无法消化他们的礼物，这支团队还是被猿类大队所吸引，沉迷这些生物的有趣行为而荒废了任务。
descriptions.en: Hard times for the science team on [From.Planet.GetName]. Progress through the jungle ground to a near halt with the unexpected discovery of a river valley winding beneath the trees. The raging waters are stuttered with sharp rocks, and have proven impassable along the team's chosen course. The resulting detour has had surprising consequences: the arrival of a gregarious troop of local simians. These slope-browed creatures have delighted in entertaining the expedition, arriving each night laden with an extremely potent variety of fermented berry. Despite our inability to digest their gift, the team has nevertheless taken to the troop, indulging the creatures' antics at the expense of the mission.

descriptions.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

所有人都无能为力 —— 一瞬间，§H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! 和其他几个 [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] 被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。
descriptions.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

There was nothing anyone could have done - within moments, §H[dead_scientist.GetName]§! and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths.

descriptions.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

一瞬间，几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。幸运的是，§H[Root.GetLeaderName]§!当时在空间站的不同区段，但这对调查工作来说仍是一个重大挫折。
descriptions.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Within moments, several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths. Fortunately, §H[Root.GetLeaderName]§! was in a different section of the station at the time, but this is nevertheless a significant setback for the investigation effort.

descriptions.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。似乎也没有重要设备损坏，因此调查不会因此面临任何不应有的挫折。
descriptions.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. It seems no vital equipment was damaged either, so the investigation will not face any undue setbacks as a result.

descriptions.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。因此，他们能够不受阻碍地继续他们的工作。
descriptions.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. They were therefore able continue their work undeterred.

descriptions.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。
descriptions.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。

During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

label.zh: 我们将提供他们需要的所有资金。
label.en: We shall provide all the funding they need.

label.zh: 这会耽搁我们一段时间。

descriptions.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.planet.system.GetName]恒星系中空间站的遗迹开展了持续性研究，并在这个过程中发现了少量密藏的古董物品。首席考古学家[root.leader.GetName]在其中发现了几件稀有文物。
descriptions.en: Our continued study of the remnants of the station in the [fromfrom.planet.system.GetName] system has unearthed a small cache of antique objects. Chief archaeologist [root.leader.GetName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

descriptions.zh: 当我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]正在调查附近的控制台时，空间站的一部分墙壁突然倒塌。然而，事实证明我们撞了好运，收纳有几个稀有文物的隐藏隔间随即被发现了。
descriptions.en: A section of the station's walls suddenly collapsed as our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were investigating a nearby console. This proved a fortuitous event however, as a hidden compartment concealing several minor artifacts was revealed.

descriptions.zh: 查看空间站的电子设备时，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]之一意外触发了其创建者留下的一些仍然有效的安全措施。这导致了在部署正确的对策之前，我们的团队在很长一段时间内都被排除在空间站系统之外。
descriptions.en: As they were poking through the station's electronics, one of our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] accidentally triggered some still-functional security measures left by its creators. As a result, our team were locked out from the station's systems for a considerable time before the right countermeasures could be deployed.
